terms_review.service_route: W&B Serverless Inference API uses https://api.inference.wandb.ai/v1; official W&B inference product page says hosted models run on CoreWeave infrastructure.
terms_review.inference_input_output_scope: W&B AI Terms last updated 2026-08-04 say prompts/data/text submitted as Input and generated results as Output are Customer Data between W&B and Customer, excluding W&B Background IP. The W&B MSA defines Customer Data broadly and gives W&B rights to use Customer Data to provide/improve W&B Assets, develop offerings, and provide/improve AI Features. The free-use section permits W&B to use data from free and academic customers for testing and development. No inference-specific prompt/output retention period, output-only license, or default no-improvement setting was identified in reviewed docs.
terms_review.coreweave_scope_and_retention: W&B's privacy link redirects to CoreWeave. CoreWeave Privacy Policy last updated 2026-02-24 says it collects service content including inputs/outputs and may process that content to operate, debug, evaluate, develop, improve, and optimize products/services. It gives personal-data retention as only as long as needed, with deletion/anonymization/isolation after; this policy explicitly excludes data processed solely as a processor/customer data, so it does not specify exact inference request retention for W&B customer data. CoreWeave hosted-inference path is evidenced by W&B's official inference page.
terms_review.remote_research_finetuning_transfer: W&B AI Terms treat Input/Output as Customer Data between the parties and require Customer to hold input rights; the MSA lets W&B process Customer Data to provide/improve W&B Assets and AI Features and does not expressly restrict the Customer's reuse of outputs. For new fully first-party authored synthetic prompts with no external seed text or personal/regulated data, routing Qwen outputs back to W&B's own SFT service is a reasonable documented basis for research-only fine-tuning under the same provider terms; this is not a legal guarantee and includes W&B's stated product-improvement/testing-development rights. No clause located that expressly prohibits Customer reuse or third-party transfer of outputs, but no distinct blanket output license or upstream seed-data rights were found. This basis does not clear historical outputs whose generator/model/terms are unknown or imply permission to transfer to another provider without applying that provider's terms.
